reality_check.line: Headlines sound worried, but the market signals are calm — likely media noise so far.

narrative.nudge: In the 19 most similar past setups, sharp drops were uncommon and the market was higher a month later 58% of the time. Reacting impulsively to weeks like this has usually cost more than it saved.
